author: NASS
description:
Step into San Francisco’s Market Street in 1906 like never before.

This new 2026 restoration presents a rare visual journey through the city before the earthquake, followed by powerful footage captured after the devastating disaster. It reveals one of the most dramatic transformations in urban history.

Combined with traditional restoration methods and Using my latest restoration pipeline and advanced semantic colorization techniques, this version delivers improved detail and Advanced Colorization, clearer textures, and a more immersive cinematic experience than previous editions.


📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to 4K
• Manual color corrections
